name: architect
description: /architect is the drawings step of the build loop: one interview after /precon that settles the walkthrough target (a named first user, a date, what they must do), forces 2-3 genuinely distinct candidate structures into the open, grills them with Occam's razor, and settles the one-way doors for the full vision while construction stays MVP-sized. Produces one living architecture doc that /sunrise provisions from and /blueprint slices from, plus a private visual artifact and an optional blind outside-model review. Doc only, never provisions. Strictly user-invoked.
